mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with increased corporate costs.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500K signals strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST > 1500K does not correlate with economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances following a decrease in FEDFUNDS, or the easing policy does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% MoM signals increased economic output, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM growth > 2% does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in RSAFS and decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which is a negative indicator for economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or a decrease in PAYEMS does not correlate with economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary tightening cycle with controlled inflation, which is a positive regime for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in FEDFUNDS and decrease in CPIAUCSL does not correlate with a positive regime.
